Third-party software in the Holotable viewer kit (swu-viewer-kit.js and swu-viewer-kit.mjs)

The kit bundles these packages from npm, each under its own license. The license texts the packages ship
follow the list, each text once. The kit itself is MIT licensed (https://github.com/ericfode/holotable).

@reduxjs/toolkit 2.13.0 (MIT): text 1
animejs 4.5.0 (MIT): text 2
clsx 2.1.1 (MIT): text 3
d3-array 3.2.4 (ISC): text 4
d3-color 3.1.0 (ISC): text 5

d3-interpolate 3.0.1 (ISC): text 7
d3-path 3.1.0 (ISC): text 8
d3-scale 4.0.2 (ISC): text 7
d3-shape 3.2.0 (ISC): text 5
d3-time 3.1.0 (ISC): text 5
d3-time-format 4.1.0 (ISC): text 7
decimal.js-light 2.5.1 (MIT): text 9

eventemitter3 5.0.4 (MIT): text 12
framer-motion 14.1.0 (MIT): text 13
